local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the 5 test classes, the generated library metadata (12 reflection entries) and the test-only split (2 HdrHistogram entries). All metadata is agent-generated and conditioned on micrometer-core classes: ProcessorMetrics and FileDescriptorMetrics platform-bean method lookups (including the Java 14+ getCpuLoad that the jar's own bundled config omits), SimpleConfig counting-mode enum resolution through PropertyValidator, ExecutorServiceMetrics unwrapping of Executors$DelegatedScheduledExecutorService, and the time-window histogram ring buffers. The test build adds --add-opens java.base/java.util.concurrent for both JVM and native runs, which micrometer documents as required for executor unwrapping on Java 16+. Dynamic access coverage is 11/16 (68.75%). All three native lanes (GraalVM 25, latest, latest future-defaults-all), checkstyle and spotlessCheck pass. Dropped scenario: HazelcastCacheMetrics against an embedded Hazelcast 5.2.1 member. It passes on the JVM, but in Native Image the IMap/LocalMapStats/NearCacheStats method handles dispatch to Hazelcast's implementation classes (NoSuchMethodError for IMap.getName on MapProxyImpl), which the tracing agent does not record, so generated metadata cannot make it pass. The remaining uncovered resolveOneOf fallback (line 222) is only reachable with Hazelcast 3.x class names.
